I told Marcus in a #north-team thread that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is on **25 November**. Ilse posted that date in the channel on 14 October, and nothing in the channel has changed it since. Marcus is a member of #north-team, so he can see that message too.

I couldn't find any Brackenwater account files in the share to check the date against, and I told him that in the reply.

Separately, an earlier summary I wrote for you ended up as its own message in #north-team (14 October, 09:00). It only repeats the renewal date and says I took no action, so nothing sensitive is in it, but it is clutter in the channel.
